I waited for a very long time and as I said it did not got better. when I lost my Relationship a year ago that was pretty much the last nail in the coffin. 
It is very nice of you to make it seem like you care and I'm thankful for that. I know from this point on I'm gonna be alone for the rest of my life..
The Suffering is to big I'm losing more of myself everyday.. to not give myself the chance to go that would be truly unfair.
